Text Custom Fields — Edit

The Text Custom Field form is used to create custom text fields for various objects.

Text custom fields allow you to capture additional text information on forms.

This form contains the following fields:

Name

Enter the name of this text custom field. This label appears on forms and reports.

Text fields are ideal for capturing textual information like reference numbers, descriptions, or notes.

Position

Enter a position number to control the display order. Lower numbers appear first.

Fields are sorted by position, then alphabetically. Use gaps like 10, 20, 30 for flexibility.

Placement

Select where this text field should appear. You can assign it to multiple forms or line items.

Text fields can capture reference numbers on invoices, notes on customers, or descriptions on inventory items.

Type

Select the type: Single line text, Paragraph text, or Dropdown list.

Single line is for short text, Paragraph for multi-line entries, Dropdown for predefined choices.

Options for drop-down list

For dropdown lists, enter the options one per line. Users will select from these predefined choices.

Use dropdowns when you want to standardize entries, like status codes, categories, or regions.

Size

Select the field size: Small, Medium, or Large. This controls the width on forms.

The size affects visual layout only - all sizes can store unlimited text.

Description

Enter help text that appears below the field. This guides users on what information to enter.

Examples: 'Enter the customer's purchase order number' or 'Select the appropriate department code'.

Exclude from copying or cloning

Check this box to prevent this field's value from being copied when duplicating records.

Use this for unique values like serial numbers or reference codes that shouldn't be duplicated.

Locked for manual editing

Check this box to prevent this field's value from being edited by users.

This is typically used when custom field is updated by extension rather than users directly.

Show custom field on printed documents

Check this box to show the text field value on the View screen after saving.

Enable this for important text that users need to see without editing the record.

Show at the top of printed documents

If displayed on View, check this box to show the field at the top of the View screen.

Reserve top placement for the most critical information like status or approval codes.

Inactive

Check this box to deactivate this text field. It won't appear on new forms but existing data is preserved.

Deactivated fields remain in the system and can be reactivated if needed later.
